scope: visible case ZIP format and extraction
read-only released payload inspection for N, S and T

checks.command: ruff check scripts/case_package.py scripts/tool_policy.py scripts/inspect_released_payload.py tests/test_case_package.py tests/test_tool_policy.py tests/test_inspect_released_payload.py

adversarial_review.case_ancestor_rename: reproduced false success, then rejected after full path checks
adversarial_review.case_review_after_fix: no actionable findings within declared contract
adversarial_review.policy_review_after_fix: no confirmed findings within declared contract
adversarial_review.integrated_release_review: no actionable false green within declared offline contract
adversarial_review.reviewers: native development agents, not accredited independent human judges

limitations: D-E is public development material, not a reserved blind case
format checks cannot detect a hidden answer embedded or paraphrased in visible files
same-UID processes can race a point-in-time path check after it returns
caller-supplied schedule, hashes, runtime image and tool identities are not externally authenticated
the policy is declarative and does not enforce OS isolation, network, tools or runtime caps
T toolkit content and installation are not checked
no provider execution, authenticated telemetry, receipts, blind scoring or sealed custody occurred
